# add_pocket_psds_to_rag_from_segmentation { #mofography.compute.add_pocket_psds_to_rag_from_segmentation }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-alternate">alternate</span> Convenience to copy pocket PSDs from a segmentation dict onto an existing RAG.

```python
compute.add_pocket_psds_to_rag_from_segmentation(
    rag,
    segmentation,
    atoms,
    *,
    pocket_psds=None,
    props=None,
    pbc_groups=None,
    probe_radius_psd=None,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Attach probe pocket PSDs to a RAG built from segmentation.

Uses ``segmentation['pocket_psds']`` when present (see
:func:`~mofography.workflow.enrich_segmentation_with_pocket_psds`);
otherwise runs :func:`~mofography.rust_fun.compute_pocket_psds_for_segmentation`.

Node keys written: ``pocket_psd_x_pbc`` / ``pocket_psd_y_pbc``.
